params.memo: Optional repayment reference — attached via Arc Memo contract.

MEMO_CONTRACT().notice: Arc Memo contract address (same on testnet and mainnet).

estimateGasCostUsdc(uint256).notice: Estimate USD cost of a pool action at current base fee.         On Arc gas is paid in USDC (native, 18 decimals).         Returns cost in 1e6 USDC units (ERC-20 USDC decimals).

permit2Repay(address,uint256,uint256,uin.notice: Use a Permit2 signature to transfer `amount` then repay caller's debt.

permit2Supply(address,uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Use a Permit2 signature to transfer `amount` of `asset` then supply.         Eliminates a separate approve() transaction.         Tokens land in the router; supply is immediately booked to msg.sender.

repayAllAndClose(address,uint256,address.notice: Repay full debt and withdraw all collateral (close position).         Caller should pass type(uint256).max for maxDebtAmount.

repayAndWithdraw(address,uint256,address.notice: Atomically repay debt and withdraw collateral.         Positions are adjusted on msg.sender's account.

rescueTokens(address,address,uint256).notice: Rescue ERC-20 tokens stranded in the router.         Only callable by admin (governance / multisig).         Used when a Permit2 nonce was consumed out-of-band, leaving tokens         inside the router with no pending flow to consume them.

supplyAndBorrow(address,uint256,address,.notice: Atomically supply collateral and borrow in a single transaction.         Positions are booked to msg.sender, never to this router.         Caller must approve collateralAsset to this router (or use permit2Supply).
